description: Provision an AWS Apigatewayv2 DomainName via the ACK apigatewayv2 controller. Fields mirror the apigatewayv2.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1 DomainName spec.

certificateName.description: A string with a length between [1-128].

securityPolicy.description:
The Transport Layer Security (TLS) version of the security policy for this
domain name. The valid values are TLS_1_0 and TLS_1_2.

mutualTLSAuthentication.description: The mutual TLS authentication configuration for a custom domain name.

truststoreURI.description: A string representation of a URI with a length between [1-2048].

truststoreVersion.description: A string with a length between [1-64].

region.description: AWS region for this resource (e.g. eu-west-1). Rendered as the services.k8s.aws/region annotation. Empty inherits the ACK controller's default region.
region.title: AWS region

tags.description: The collection of tags associated with a domain name.

title: AWS Apigatewayv2 DomainName
